purpose: Evaluate a conservative training-free control policy on top of the locked BLEND baseline. The policy may suppress an already-planned evidence contact when a non-parametric memory of pre-acquisition state, action, and observed return provides unanimous local evidence that acquisition has no positive primary-task return. It never widens dispatch, never generates an answer, and never imputes an unlogged action outcome.
authority: owner goal: preserve workspace for and establish a measurable training-free RL contribution

baseline.form: locked v1 two-contact knowledge-conditioned decode with alpha 0.45

scope.eligible: trajectories the locked v1 policy already dispatches and for which the sealed record contains both the trajectory's own direct response and its own evidence response
actions: ACQUIRE: retain the locked baseline's evidence contact and final response
STOP: suppress that evidence contact and select the same frozen core's own direct response
scope.answer_authority: both selectable responses were generated by the same frozen core

two_stage_read_boundary.stage_1_fit: read DEV-100 round 4 only; write and commit a self-hashed policy artifact
two_stage_read_boundary.stage_2_holdout: the separate evaluate command may read DEV-500-NEW400 only when the committed artifact records support_gate_passed=true

discovery.name: DEV-100-ROUND4
discovery.role: memory construction and internal grouped support gate

holdout.name: DEV-500-NEW400
holdout.role: retrospective held-out replication; utterance groups present in discovery memory are excluded before evaluation
holdout.exposure: already opened by the registered DEV-500 read; no new gold surface

state.runtime_legality: all fields exist after direct decode plus recall/rank/fuse and before the evidence contact

policy.distance: mean absolute distance in the fixed bounded state space
policy.decision: STOP only when at least k neighbors lie inside radius and every neighbor has observed ACQUIRE-minus-STOP primary return <= 0; otherwise ACQUIRE

discovery_selection.split: whole utterance groups assigned deterministically 70 percent tune and 30 percent support gate
discovery_selection.tune_admission: at least 2 STOP decisions and zero harmful STOP decisions under leave-one-utterance-group-out replay
discovery_selection.tie_break: maximize contacts saved, then prefer larger k, then smaller radius
discovery_selection.support_gate: zero harmful STOP decisions and at least max(2, ceil(10 percent of gate n)) STOP decisions
discovery_selection.failure: write a failed artifact and do not read holdout rewards

control: helpful, harmful, and neutral STOP decomposition
acquisition return separated by chosen action
holdout_metrics.uncertainty: paired cluster bootstrap with 10000 replicates and seed 20260807

claim_boundary: A pass establishes a Stage-2 retrospective training-free control-plane contribution on already-exposed devel data. It does not revise the locked baseline, establish test performance, confirm generality, authorize a model contact, or authorize Stage-3 work.
